items.title: Build the LAN-enabled Windows release
items.completion_note: The standard and LAN executables, checksum files, required support files, and final 30.5 MB release ZIP were produced. The Archiver 8 ZipArchive correction passed in both ZIP stages.

items.title: Smoke-test the packaged release from a clean folder
items.completion_note: The extracted package ran across two LAN computers. The remote browser worked, and the main and actor OBS overlays rendered after the generated root certificate was installed and browser/OBS processes were restarted on the OBS computer.

items.completion_note: Release validation and remaining promotion steps were documented before promotion.

items.title: Promote Phase 2 AI Actors into agent/lan-mode
items.completion_note: The owner explicitly approved marking PR #8 ready and then merging it. PR #8 is closed and merged into agent/lan-mode.

items.title: Retest the combined LAN integration branch
items.completion_note: The owner confirmed the combined branch was in working order across localhost mode, secure LAN registration and assets, AI Actors, Streamer.bot serial TTS, remote OBS rendering, and LAN restart recovery.
acceptance_criteria: The default launcher remains localhost-only and the normal control panel and overlay still work
Secure LAN certificate setup and trusted remote HTTPS access work
Machine registration, global models, private uploads, model selection, and emotes work
AI Actor creation, actor overlays, expressions, speaking state, reset, emotes, and nested sub-animations work
Streamer.bot reaches the actor API and mapped serial TTS returns each actor to idle
Main and actor OBS sources render remotely and recover after the LAN process restarts
No live machine token, actor token, complete authenticated OBS URL, certificate key, or password is recorded

items.notes: Combined regression is complete. Marking PR #1 ready and merging PR #1 remain separate actions and each requires an explicit owner instruction.

maintenance.rule: When an item is completed, record the result in project-status.json, mark the roadmap item complete, update updated_at in all three JSON records, and add a concise CHANGELOG.md entry.
maintenance.checkout_rule: Use npm ci, then run npm run status:check after fetching and before beginning the next work item.
maintenance.security: Never place live tokens, authenticated OBS URLs, or certificate secrets in roadmap files.
